coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: Sixteen scanned pictures of 826 x 1076 px (about 0.736 pt a pixel), each drawn over two landscape PDF pages (top part at y 27.7, bottom part at y -528.7; the page shows y 28.8-583.2). Lines and squares located on the picture's pixels along the scan's tilt (tlines.py, squares.py in work-g1), converted through the drawing matrix; every picture page looked at; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: An executed private placement subscription agreement filed as scanned page pictures, each picture split across two landscape PDF pages: the subscriber completes the signature pages (information, amount, registration choice, initials) and signs; the company completes and signs the acceptance section. No joint investor block; a custodian is only mentioned in an instruction line.
